name: Mimetas OrganoPlate 3-lane 40 4004-400-B 384 well
author: Ramona Optics
notes:
Dimensions are in meters. Registered on the plate's 384-well microtitre lattice, which is what the rows/columns/pitch schema expresses and what a full-coverage acquisition mode needs to reach every chip; the chip lattice is described below but is not what this file's grid encodes.

CONTROLLING DOCUMENT. MIMETAS drawing '3-lane 40 (4004-400-B)', REV. F, dated 2026-06-01, scale 1:1, unit mm, designed by F. Schavemaker, checked and approved by B. Trietsch, marked '- Confidential-'. The file supplied was named '20260601_3-lane 40 (4004-400-B) Technical Drawing Rev_F edit.pdf'; the '_edit' suffix is the sender's, and it is unconfirmed whether the file differs from MIMETAS' own Rev F. This drawing is confidential and is not published by MIMETAS; it is on file at Ramona Optics (Slack DM, 2026-09-15, forwarded by Jarrett Bliton for the GSK demo) rather than online. web_reference therefore points at the MIMETAS product page, which is the highest-authority PUBLIC document; the product specification flyer for 4004-400-B was also read and is cited below.

FROM THE DRAWING, as dimensioned callouts: outer_plate_dimensions.length 127.80 +/- 0.2 mm; width 85.50 +/- 0.2 mm; height 14.4 +/- 0.1 mm (overall plate height, Section A-A; no lid is shown or dimensioned on the drawing). alignment_reference.offset_from_left_edge 12.1 +/- 0.05 mm and offset_from_top_edge 9 +/- 0.05 mm, both taken off the outer plate edges in the Top View; the drawing carries no datum symbols and never labels a well 'A1', so A1 is taken to be the corner well nearest those two edges. well_dimensions.pitch 4.50 mm. The drawing prints 127.80 x 85.50, not the ANSI/SLAS 4-2004 nominal 127.76 x 85.48; the drawing's numbers are used here. Note the plate is NOT a 127.76 footprint with a 12.13/8.99 A1 -- the vendor's own values are close to but not the standard's.

SCALED OFF THE DRAWING, not dimensioned: well_dimensions.diameter 0.0036 m is the top opening of the rounded-square microtitre well, flat-to-flat. MIMETAS does not dimension the well opening on any of the three OrganoPlate drawings. It was measured off the 1:1 vector geometry three times and independently: 3.61 mm on 4004-400-B Rev F (1200 dpi raster, calibrated on the 4.50 mm pitch), 3.65 mm on 6405-400-B Rev E and 3.68 mm on 6401-400-B Rev D (PDF path coordinates, calibrated on the 127.80 mm footprint; those two are stroke-centreline, inside-of-stroke gives 3.55 and 3.58). All three close on the pitch against the measured rib between openings (3.61 + 0.89 = 4.50). 0.0036 m is the rounded consensus. The rounded-square corner radius is about 0.5 mm, also scaled and not dimensioned. The schema has no square field, so the flat-to-flat width is recorded in 'diameter' and 'shape' is 'square'; the Ø2.00 mm figure that appears on the drawings is the chip access aperture in the floor of the well, NOT the well opening, and must not be used as the diameter.

DERIVED: well_dimensions.depth 0.01159 m = 14.4 mm overall plate height minus 2.81 mm, the drawing's 'Distance to top of top glass', both measured from the bottom face of the plate skirt. The drawing does not dimension well depth. The derivation is corroborated by scaling the well wall height off Section A-A (1:1) at about 11.64 mm. bottom_shape 'flat' is from the depiction in Section A-A -- tapered (draft) walls standing on a flat laminate floor -- and is not stated as a note.

BOTTOM THICKNESS AND WORKING DISTANCE. This is the number that decides whether the objective can focus. The drawing's note block, all measured from the bottom face of the plate skirt: 'Glass substrate thickness: .15' (150 um, 1H coverslip thickness per the flyer); 'Microfluidics height: .22'; 'Distance to bottom glass 2.29'; 'Distance to focal plane: 2.44'; 'Distance to top of top glass: 2.81'. The stack closes: 2.29 + 0.15 = 2.44, so the focal plane is the top surface of the 150 um bottom glass, i.e. 2.44 mm above the plate underside. Materials per the flyer: top plate virgin polystyrene, bottom plate optical quality 150 um glass, microfluidics glass and proprietary polymers. The drawing itself says only 'Glass substrate' with no grade.

CHIP LAYOUT. 40 tissue culture chips on a 9.00 x 9.00 mm lattice, 5 chip-rows x 8 chip-columns, counted off the Bottom View. Each chip spans a 3 x 3 block of well positions and is connected to 7 of them: 6 Ø2.00 mm access wells at the corners and mid-sides, plus the central well, which is the observation window and carries the 2.2 mm dimension on the flyer's chip view. The top-centre and bottom-centre positions of each 3 x 3 block are blank. 5 chip-rows x 3 = 15 well-rows, so the 16th (bottom) well-row of 24 wells has no chip under it at all. Totals: 40 x 7 = 280 chip-connected wells, 104 with no chip connection (80 blank in-block + 24 in the chip-less bottom row). All 384 openings are moulded identically; only what is drawn inside them differs. A full-coverage acquisition mode over the 16 x 24 grid therefore images 104 positions that hold no chip.

NOT AVAILABLE FROM ANY DOCUMENT READ: footprint corner radius, skirt/flange height, lid height, plate colour, surface treatment, sterility statement, and well volumes (the flyer gives medium volume 50 uL recommended per well, 15-90 uL possible, and ECM-gel loading volume 2.0 uL, which are working volumes rather than geometric ones).

OTHER DOCUMENTS READ: MIMETAS product specification flyer 'OrganoPlate 3-lane 40, Product code 4004-400-B' (2022), read from the distributor-rehosted copy at https://www.ycytek.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/202_Flyer_OrganoPlate-3-lane-40-product-specifications.pdf.pdf because the MIMETAS-hosted path www.mimetas.com/files/products/ now 404s after their site move. It states: SBS Standard 384 well plate; 40 cultures per plate; a chip connects to 7 wells in a 3x3 well grid with the central well providing viewing access; side channels 300 um, middle channel 350 um, channel height 220 um, PhaseGuide 100 x 55 um; internal volumes side 1.7 uL, middle 1.4 uL; gel-medium interface 0.57 mm2.

SIBLING PART NUMBERS in the same OrganoPlate family, not registered here: 4004-400-B (3-lane 40), 6405-400-B (3-lane 64), 6401-400-B (Graft), 9603-400-B (2-lane 96). All share the 127.80 x 85.50 x 14.4 mm 384-well top and differ in the microfluidic layer.

DISAGREEMENT BETWEEN VENDOR DOCUMENTS: the flyer says 'SBS Standard 384 well plate' while the drawing prints 127.80 x 85.50 rather than the standard's 127.76 x 85.48, and the flyer's 300 um side-channel width has no counterpart anywhere on the drawing (Section C-C prints .520/.220/.055 and .35/.55/1.15, unlabelled). The drawing wins in this file. The flyer's '384 well format' is also true only in the geometric sense -- 104 of the 384 wells are not connected to a chip.

PUBLIC CORROBORATION OF THE FOOTPRINT. web_reference is the 2021 MIMETAS product specification flyer for this part, the only public MIMETAS document that prints a footprint in text for any of the three plates: 'Plate format - SBS-standard 384-well plate, 127.8 x 85.5 x 14.4 mm (l x w x h) (17.2 mm height with lid)'. It agrees with drawing Rev F exactly. The plate height recorded here is the 14.4 mm without-lid figure, per the schema; the lid adds 2.8 mm. The MIMETAS files/ tree is dead since their 2025 site move, so the citation is a Wayback id_ capture; the live product page is https://www.mimetas.com/en/organoplate-3-lane-40/ . An archived MIMETAS FAQ page instead gives '127.76 x 85.48 x 14.8 mm ... 17.3 mm height with lid' for 'the OrganoPlate' generically, which contradicts both the drawing and the flyer; the drawing is the only source carrying tolerances and is what this file follows. MIMETAS' 2-lane 96 flyer gives 85.8 mm width for that different product, so the vendor's own flyers are not mutually consistent on width. US patent 10,532,355 B2 (MIMETAS B.V.) independently states the 4.5 mm 384-well pitch.
